# PopupSelect

Popup select: one list in a Popup, applied the moment a row is picked. - **One list, applied on pick.** Picking a row sets the value, the menu fades out, and focus goes back to the trigger. There is no Apply. - **Two triggers.** With `label` and no `trigger`, the labeled trigger reads "Status: Upcoming" with a chevron, as the view switch under page tabs. Pass `trigger` for anything else, such as a filter button in a section's view bar; a function gets `{ isOpen, option }`. - **Placement follows the trigger's side.** A trigger at the start of a bar opens `bottom-start` (the default); one at the end opens `bottom-end`. - **Width** is Popup's `auto`: at least the trigger, 160 to 320. - **Marker** is a radio before the label: one choice among several. `marker="check"` puts a check at the row's end. - **Search** sits above the list and filters it. Short lists turn it off with `isSearchable={false}`. The list is Select's own: the same rows, keys and messages.

**Import:** `import { PopupSelect } from '@/components';`

## Usage

Use `PopupSelect` when one pick from one list immediately changes what the page shows, with no field and no Apply button:

- **A view switch** under page tabs, such as "Status: Upcoming" (pass `label` and no `trigger`).
- **One filter** in a section's view bar, such as Subject (pass a `FilterButton` as `trigger`).

## Motion

PopupSelect reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Clips open from the trigger's corner on the side it is aligned to. |
| exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Fades. The exit is the fade. |

## Alternatives

- For a value that belongs to a form field, use `Select`.
- For several filter categories staged and applied together, use `FilterMenu`.
- For a menu of actions rather than values, use `DropdownMenu`.

## Best practices

### Line the menu up with its trigger's side. {#line-the-menu-up-with-its-trigger-s-side}

Start-of-bar triggers open `bottom-start` and end-of-bar triggers open `bottom-end`, so the menu never hangs past its own bar.

### Turn search off for a short list. {#turn-search-off-for-a-short-list}

Pass `isSearchable={false}` when a list has only a few options that scan at a glance.

### Show the active value on the trigger. {#show-the-active-value-on-the-trigger}

The built-in labeled trigger shows the value automatically; with a custom `FilterButton` trigger, pass the applied count as `trailingMetric`.

### Keep it to one list. {#keep-it-to-one-list}

Two lists, or picks that wait for an Apply, are a different menu.

## Accessibility

- **The trigger is a real button** that says a popup opens and whether it is
  open. The labeled trigger's name carries the value: "Status: Upcoming".
- **The popup is named** by `label`, and so is the list inside it.
- **The search field is the list's combobox.** Focus stays in it while the
  arrow keys move the highlighted row (`aria-activedescendant`). Without
  search, focus goes to the list itself.
- **Focus returns to the trigger** after a pick or Escape.

## Related

- `Select`: use when picking a value inside a form field.
- `FilterMenu`: use when staging and applying several filter categories together.
- `DropdownMenu`: use when opening a menu of actions rather than values.

## Parts

1. **Trigger.** The labeled trigger is a subtle `FilterButton` reading "Label: Value" with a chevron. Any other trigger is the caller's.
2. **Popup.** A `Popup` at `width="auto"`: at least the trigger's width, never under 160, up to 320. It sits 4 from the trigger.
3. **Search** (optional). A compact search field above the list, on by default. Turn it off with `isSearchable={false}` for a short list.
4. **List.** `Select`'s list: the same rows, groups, descriptions and messages. The picked row takes the selected fill and a radio before its label, since the menu picks one value. `marker="check"` draws a check at the row's end instead.

### Placement

| Trigger | `placement` |
| --- | --- |
| At the start of a bar, or alone | `bottom-start` (default): the menu's start edge meets the trigger's. |
| At the end of a bar | `bottom-end`: the menu's end edge meets the trigger's. |

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Open | The menu clips open from the trigger's corner. A keyboard open is instant. |
| Hovered row | The row takes the hovered fill; it is also the keyboard cursor. |
| Picked | The row changes color, then the menu fades and the content behind it swaps in place. Nothing slides. |
| No match | One "No results" row; set your own with `emptyMessage`. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Surface | Those of `Popup`: `--ds-surface-overlay`, `--ds-shadow-overlay`, `--popup-radius`. |
| Inset of the rows | 4: `--popover-pad-menu`. |
| Width | `--popup-min-width` to `--popup-max-width`, and at least the trigger. |
| Height of the list | Scrolls past 320: `--popover-max-height-menu`. |
| Gap to the trigger | 4: `--popover-offset`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name what is picked: "Status", "Subject". | A verb phrase such as "Filter by status". |
| Use short option labels in sentence case: "Upcoming". | Labels long enough to wrap or truncate. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `container` | object | — | Where the open menu mounts: an element. Leave it out for the page's overlay layer; name one to keep the menu inside a picture or a scrolling region. |
| `options` | arrayOf | `[]` | Strings, or objects with `value`, `label`, `description`, `disabled` and `group`, as Select takes. |
| `value` | string or number | — | The picked option's `value`. Leave it out to let the menu keep its own. |
| `defaultValue` | string or number | — | The value it starts with, when `value` is left out. |
| `onChange` | func | — | `(value, option)`, called the moment a row is picked. |
| `label` | string | — | What is being picked, such as "Status". Names the menu, and with no `trigger` it heads the labeled trigger: "Status: Upcoming". |
| `trigger` | node or func | — | A trigger of your own, or `({ isOpen, option }) => node`. Without it the labeled trigger is drawn. |
| `placement` | enum | `'bottom-start'` | `bottom-start` (default) for a trigger at the start of a bar, `bottom-end` for one at its end. |
| `isSearchable` | bool | `true` | A search field above the list. Turn it off for a short list. |
| `searchPlaceholder` | string | `'Search'` | The search field's placeholder. |
| `open` | bool | — | Whether the menu is open. Leave it out to let the trigger open and close it. |
| `defaultOpen` | bool | `false` | Opens the menu on first render, when `open` is left out. |
| `onOpenChange` | func | — | `(open)`. |
| `marker` | enum | `'radio'` | `radio` (default) marks the picked row with a radio before its label; `check` puts a check at the row's end. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` draws 32 rows and a 32 trigger; `compact` draws 24 rows and a 24 trigger. |
| `emptyMessage` | node | `'No results'` | Shown when the search matches nothing. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra classes on the popup. |
| `id` | string | — | The popup's id; the list's id is this plus `-listbox`. |

## Variants

**`placement`** — `bottom-start` · `bottom-end`

**`marker`** — `radio` · `check`

**`spacing`** — `default` · `compact`

The named string values each prop takes. A prop's full type is in Props: a prop listed here may also take a boolean or a number, and a prop missing here may still have named values.
